title: Add pagination, sorting and filtering to the employee listing endpoint
criteria: `GET /api/v1/employees` accepts optional query parameters `page` (0-based, default `0`) and `size` (default `20`, capped at `100` — a request for a larger size is clamped, not rejected).

`GET /api/v1/employees` accepts an optional `sort` query parameter in the form `field,direction` (e.g. `sort=lastName,asc`, `sort=salary,desc`), restricted to real `Employee` fields (`firstName`, `lastName`, `email`, `department`, `salary`, `createdAt`). An unknown field or direction returns `400 Bad Request` with the existing `ErrorResponse` shape (see `GlobalExceptionHandler`), not a 500.
`GET /api/v1/employees` accepts optional `department` and `active` query parameters that filter the result set when present, and are ignored (no filter applied) when absent.
The response body changes from a bare JSON array to a page envelope carrying `content` (the list of `EmployeeResponse`), `page`, `size`, `totalElements`, and `totalPages`.

Calling the endpoint with no query parameters at all still returns HTTP 200 with the first page (default size) rather than erroring — existing manual/API-doc examples keep working, just with a different response shape (see **Risks** below).
`/api/v1/employees/search` and `/api/v1/employees/high-earners` are unchanged by this story.
